options.text: 1.8 mm
1.6 mm

question: When the speed increases while driving round a bend, the push of the centrifugal force will

options.text: Be greater.
Be lesser.

question: To avoid skidding on a wet road when stopping, you should always

options.text: Apply intermittent (on/off) braking technique.
Depress the clutch pedal followed by the brake pedal.
Depress the brake pedal and apply the handbrake together.

question: If the frictional force is reduced on wet road, the stopping distance will be

options.text: The same.
Longer.
Shorter.

options.text: The clutch pedal first followed by the brake pedal.

options.text: Close your eyes.

options.text: Signal is about to be cancelled.

options.text: Depress the brake and the clutch pedals simultaneously.
Shift to neutral and step on the brakes.

options.text: Give way to them.

options.text: Move close behind so you can pass quickly.

question: In a traffic hold-up, you should

options.text: Switch off the engine.

options.text: Travelling at a high speed over a long distance.
